hero_copy.text: Stow makes everyday archive work feel calm and deliberate. Mac gets the complete archive toolkit. iPhone and iPad stay focused on the Files workflows you need on the move.

hero_note.text: One purchase. No account. No tracking.

feature_copy.text: Stow keeps the common path simple, then gives you the control you need when a file deserves more care.

feature_verify_copy.text: Create SHA-256 checksum files and split a large archive into smaller volumes for easier transfer.

feature_pack_copy.text: Create archives from files or folders, then extract them with the right destination and options already in view.

feature_browse_copy.text: Look inside an archive on the Mac before it changes your disk. Preview its structure, then extract only what you need.

feature_protect_copy.text: Create ZIP and 7z archives with AES-256 passwords. 7z can also encrypt the list of file names.

feature_queue_copy.text: Queue several jobs, create SHA-256 checksums, and split large archives into smaller volumes.

feature_formats_copy.text: Create ZIP, 7-Zip, TAR and common compressed TAR formats. Open a broad range of archive files.

mac_copy.text: Drop something on Stow and it knows the next sensible move. The Mac app also gives you the complete archive toolkit when the job needs more than a quick ZIP.

mac_point_drop.text: Drag files or folders in to pack or unpack

mac_point_browse.text: Browse an archive and selectively extract its contents

mac_point_finder.text: Use Finder contextual actions for compression and extraction

mac_point_options.text: Keep advanced settings close, not in the way

mobile_copy.text: Mobile Stow is a focused companion for packing and unpacking the files already on your device.

mobile_point_choose.text: Choose files and folders from Files

mobile_point_filter.text: Exclude hidden files or macOS metadata

mobile_point_queue.text: Track current and completed work in a clear queue

scope_title.text: The right tool for each device.

scope_copy.text: Mac has the full archive workstation. Mobile stays fast and focused on file workflows that make sense on a touch device.

scope_point_mobile.text: Mobile never pretends to mirror every Mac workflow

scope_point_platform.text: Both versions are designed around their platform

scope_point_privacy.text: Privacy is built into the whole product

closing_title.text: Less time managing files. More confidence sending them.

closing_copy.text: Stow is built for the routine transfer, the careful backup, and the archive you want to understand before opening.

privacy_short.text: Short version: Stow does not collect, track, sell, or transmit your personal data. There are no accounts, analytics, advertising, or third-party tracking SDKs.

privacy_collect_copy.text: Nothing. Stow works with files you choose on your device. Your archive contents, file names, passwords, settings, and work queue remain on your device.

privacy_access_copy.text: Stow accesses files only after you choose them or grant a folder permission. On Mac, it may remember a folder permission that you explicitly granted so it can write the result there again. You can revoke those permissions in macOS settings or by choosing a different location.

privacy_passwords_copy.text: If you choose to save a default archive password on Mac, Stow stores it in the Apple Keychain. It is not sent to CorvusDevs or to any other service. Passwords that you enter for a single archive are used only to perform that archive operation.

privacy_network_copy.text: Stow's archive features do not contact servers operated by CorvusDevs or third parties. Tapping a support email link opens your chosen mail app, which then handles any message you decide to send. If you request an App Store rating, Apple handles that request through its system service.

privacy_store_copy.text: Apple may process information related to downloading, purchasing, or reviewing the app under its own privacy policy. CorvusDevs does not receive your Apple Account information from Stow.

privacy_children_copy.text: Stow collects no information from anyone, including children.

privacy_changes_copy.text: If this policy changes, the updated policy will appear here with a new date.

privacy_contact_copy.text: Questions about privacy can be sent to corvusdevs@outlook.com.

support_subtitle.text: For Stow on Mac, iPhone, and iPad

support_notice.text: Need a hand? Email corvusdevs@outlook.com with your device, system version, Stow version, the archive format, and what happened. A screenshot of the error is often useful.

support_mac_step_1.text: Drag files or folders onto the Stow window to create an archive.

support_mac_step_2.text: Drag an archive onto Stow to unpack it. Stow recognizes archive files automatically.

support_mac_step_3.text: Use the format and compression controls in Archive setup when you want to override Stow's default choice.

support_mac_step_4.text: Use the queue to follow more than one operation, or pause and cancel a job.

support_mobile_title.text: Getting started on iPhone and iPad

support_mobile_copy.text: Choose files from the Files app, choose an output format and compression level, then start the job. Stow saves its output in its Files container, where you can share or move it using the standard Files controls.

support_encryption_copy_1.text: Stow can create AES-256 encrypted ZIP and 7z archives. A 7z archive can also hide its file names when that option is selected. Keep your password somewhere safe: Stow cannot recover a forgotten password.

support_encryption_copy_2.text: When opening an encrypted archive, enter the password when Stow asks. An incorrect password and a damaged archive can look similar, so try a known-good copy if the password is accepted but extraction still fails.

support_finder_copy.text: Stow adds Compress with Stow and Extract with Stow to Finder's contextual menu. macOS requires you to enable the Finder extension once. Open Stow, then go to System Settings, General, Login Items and Extensions, Finder extensions, and enable Stow. If the menu does not appear, relaunch Finder.

support_permissions_title.text: Why did Stow ask to access a folder?

support_permissions_copy.text: macOS and iOS protect your files. Stow asks only when it needs permission to read a file you selected or write a result to a folder. On Mac, Stow can remember a folder you approved so it does not ask again for the same location.

support_formats_copy.text: Stow can create ZIP, 7-Zip, TAR, TAR.GZ, TAR.BZ2, TAR.XZ, TAR.ZST, GZIP, BZIP2, XZ, Zstandard, LZ4, and Lzip archives on Mac. Mobile focuses on ZIP, 7-Zip, TAR, TAR.GZ, GZIP, BZIP2, and XZ. Stow can open a broader range of common archive formats.

support_stuck_copy.text: Send us a message at corvusdevs@outlook.com. Do not send passwords or sensitive archive contents. You can also include the exact error message and the archive format.
